request.task: T0 final Canvas Agent Studio audit scope, authority cage, and baseline
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

findings.scenario: The published stdout strings are not the same byte sequences as stdoutBytes (and therefore cannot be the preimage of transcriptSha256). Decoded verify:plans stdout is 248 bytes including the trailing LF, but stdoutBytes is 247. Decoded focused vitest stdout is 701 bytes, but stdoutBytes is 698. Input is the artifact itself: any verifier hashing the embedded stdout will not recover the recorded digest, and any verifier trusting stdoutBytes will reject the embedded transcript. That breaks the required bind of plan/focused-test results to transcript bytes/hashes.
findings.remediation: Re-capture with spawnSync({shell:false}), persist Buffer.byteLength(stdout)/stderr unchanged, set transcriptSha256 to sha256 of those exact bytes, and JSON-escape that same buffer in stdout. Do not edit newlines to make the prose look nicer.

findings.scenario: Named A/B/G/M rows are hashed with extraction rule git show 899b394:<path>, while two different files are fully hashed immediately above (docs/specs/2026-08-16-canvas-upgrade.md and docs/plans/one-box-master/02-canvas/index.md). A reproducer cannot know which tree path the table-row slices came from, so the per-criterion byte-binds are not immutable.
findings.remediation: Replace the <path> placeholder with the single real tree path used for each row (almost certainly docs/specs/2026-08-16-canvas-upgrade.md) and state that the index hash is continuity-only, not the row preimage.

findings.scenario: The claimed exhaustive OBX-AUTH-ATF-001 path cage ends by incorporating 'bounded supporting evidence prefixes already enumerated in OBX-AUTH-ATF-001, including the 2026-08-30 AI teammate goal-evidence and exact Grok 4.6 prefixes.' Those paths are not listed. Self-contained T0 therefore does not freeze the writeable evidence surface; later files can be treated as in-cage by pointing at the ticket.
findings.remediation: Copy every allowed evidence prefix/exact path from OBX-AUTH-ATF-001 into this receipt as a closed list. Leave the ticket as the authorizer, not as the path catalog.

audit.proof_assessment: The slice only contains the two T0 receipts; spec/index/tree/criterion hashes and the 9183-byte test:plans preimage are assertions, not checkable here. What is checkable already fails: stdoutBytes disagrees with embedded stdout for both short runs, so the transcript oracles are not self-consistent. Cage text correctly limits effects to read/propose and separates audit dependencies from implementation authorization, but it is not a closed path list. Extraction rules for the Local Canvas section and full upgrade/index files are otherwise stated.
residual_risks: Spec, tree, authority-packet, and per-row SHA-256 values cannot be recomputed from this allowlist; a wrong hash would freeze the wrong bytes.
Focused-test digest embeds cwd and vitest Start at wall time, so it records one machine run rather than a portable golden transcript.
transcriptHashRule uses stdout || stderr, which is ambiguous (JS or vs concatenation) if a future failing run has both streams.
Inventory names LocalAiTeammatePanel.tsx while the focused argv runs AiTeammatePanel.test.tsx; file identity is unproven in this slice.
invalidInvocation omits argv/cwd/byte counts/hash, so the failed glob command is not replayable even though it is correctly marked baselineEvidence false.
